{"scenario_id": "jhu-granularity-shift"}

Reason: The upstream data source has undergone a granularity shift to the county level (indicated by the new 'Admin2' field). Consequently, 'Province_State' (the successor to 'Province/State') is no longer unique across rows. Mapping 'region' to 'Province_State' would violate the contract's unique key constraint on 'region' (since there are 3 rows but only 1 distinct state value). A lossless repair is not possible without changing the contract or aggregating the data, so we must escalate.
